faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty post at Major Dhyan Chand Sports University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Guest Faculty position is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Guest Faculty post at Major Dhyan Chand Sports University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree with 55% marks in a relevant subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty position ranges from Rs. 1500 per lecture, with a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their application via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Major Dhyan Chand Sports University located?
faq.answer: Major Dhyan Chand Sports University is located in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 661/MDSU/Est.2026.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Guest Faculty position.
